arguments.sql_query:
WITH AsthmaConcepts AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id 
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor 
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 195662 AND semantic_concept_type_id IN ('CLIN','DF')
  UNION
  SELECT 195662
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS children_with_asthma
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
INNER JOIN AsthmaConcepts ac ON co.condition_concept_id = ac.descendant_concept_id
INNER JOIN omop.person p ON co.person_id = p.person_id
WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birth_datetime, GETDATE()) < 18;

  SELECT descendant_concept_id 
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor 
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 195662 AND semantic_concept_type_id IN ('CLIN','DF')
)
SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS INT) AS children_with_asthma
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
INNER JOIN AsthmaDescendants ac ON co.condition_concept_id = ac.descendant_concept_id
INNER JOIN omop.person p ON co.person_id = p.person_id
WHERE DATEDIFF(YEAR, p.birth_datetime, GETDATE()) < 18;
